answer_1.quote: Open-domain dialogue systems have attracted much research attention , thanks to the success of neural generation models trained with large-scale data.

answer_2.quote: The generation-based dialogue models are evaluated both automatically and manually. Specifically, the following automatic metrics are used: 1) Perplexity (PPL) which measures how the model fits the test data; 2) BLEU which evaluates the overlap of n-grams (n=1,2) between the generated and reference responses; 3) Distinct (Dist.) measures the proportion of unique n-grams in the generated responses (n=1,2).

answer_4.quote: Manual evaluation is also performed for the generated dialogue responses following the same protocol as introduced in Section 5.3.2.
answer_4.guideline: Three annotators are employed to rate these pairs from two aspects: 1) Fluency (Flu.): whether the augmented pairs are fluent; 2) Coherency (Coh.): whether the response is coherent with the post so that they make a plausible dialogue pair.
